comparison.default: Fail closed. Compare every accounted artifact, including exact artifact names and policies. Missing, extra, truncated, corrupt or unaccounted evidence fails.
comparison.B: Byte-exact: no substitution. Unconsumed raw artifacts are retained under retained/ and compared literally.
comparison.N: Lossless normalization at the registered typed slots below, followed by byte-exact comparison.
comparison.S: Only the explicitly scoped fixture-input projection/certificates below are semantic. Their obligations are validated independently before the resulting normalized bytes are compared exactly.
comparison.json: Parsing discovers token spans only. Preserve untouched object order, whitespace, duplicate keys, number spelling, escapes, SSE framing and opaque native bytes. Do not sort/re-encode provider JSON.
comparison.http_headers: Captured request header names are lowercased and sorted; only User-Agent is excluded as language-library metadata. All other header values remain exact except registered substitutions. Response headers are lowercased and sorted; none are generically ignored.
comparison.stdout: Model stdout stays literal. Only certified auth-status output and recognized request previews receive their registered normalization.
comparison.replay: Retain complete raw evidence and full raw substitution rows outside git. Independently reconstruct normalized artifacts, policies and ledger from raw bytes; require equality before comparison or publication. Never commit a digest of a raw observation.

deny_by_default: No arbitrary UUID, ID, port, URL, date, duration, hash, length or numeric substitution.
Provider-native IDs, tool call IDs, assistant/refusal text and opaque native items stay literal.
A provider response with type and seq is not a trace event.
Instruction-like text and session-like lines injected by a fixture do not register new runner identities.
A normalization slot is admitted by its complete owner/event/path/shape and input checks, never its field name alone.
Candidates cannot update expected locks, policies, inventory or samples. No pending dependency or runtime skip is a pass.

typed_allowlist.validation: Validate the raw checkpoint envelope canonical bytes and state SHA before decoding eligible base64 fields. The original path must occur in independently retained root/child trace-source allocations or a matching run.finished reference; unbound checkpoint text cannot allocate a path or identity
typed_allowlist.replacement: Only owned root and preregistered Session/Run path components become canonical tokens. Re-encode only the changed typed JSON/base64 container, preserving native Items and unrelated bytes; checkpoint-linkage-inverse proves complete raw reconstruction

typed_allowlist.owner: Version-1 checkpoint envelopes in agents-checkpoints/ and agents-checkpoints-imports/, including frozen and root-independent migration inputs
typed_allowlist.validation: Require exact envelope declaration order/canonical encoding and SHA-256 of the actual decoded gob payload. The named frozen-v1 input additionally matches its independently pinned full-file SHA. Relocated gob is never inferred equivalent from migrated v2 evidence
typed_allowlist.replacement: None: retain and compare every envelope/gob byte literally, including root-bearing bytes. The ledger records identical before/after bytes and checksum/inverse validity; a changing absolute-root gob fixture must fail rather than acquire a mask

typed_allowlist.owner: Checkpoint history/pending UserTurn.workspace/roster, ToolOutcome.data and gc_state.inherited outcomes' data slots only
typed_allowlist.validation: Verify original canonical envelope/state and SHA first. Decode only these persisted RawMessage fields, require valid typed JSON for recursive substitutions, reject embedded trace-envelope identity discovery and unbound scopes. Opaque non-JSON bytes and assistant.native.items remain literal
typed_allowlist.replacement: Base64 of the recursively normalized exact typed JSON bytes only when an eligible inner slot changed. Preserve null/empty distinctions and untouched number/escape/order/whitespace bytes; retain inner and base64 substitutions plus whole-checkpoint inverse proof

typed_allowlist.owner: Checkpoint envelope.id and state.id only
typed_allowlist.validation: Raw envelope/state canonicality, checksum and normal ID equality must hold before substitution, except the exact independently declared corrupt-ID fixture delta. Live ID must already be registered from trace/display evidence, never the checkpoint field. Fixed synthetic 0123456789abcdef remains literal
typed_allowlist.replacement: Only the independently registered live Session ID becomes SESSION_n; recompute the state digest separately and retain exact original/replacement spans under the whole-checkpoint inverse certificate

typed_allowlist.owner: Checkpoint state.launch and state.active path leaves
typed_allowlist.validation: Canonical envelope/state and original state SHA are validated first. Path must equal or descend at a slash boundary from independently allocated capture workspace/root/artifact roots; foreign paths do not become witnesses
typed_allowlist.replacement: Only the owned allocation-root prefix and already witnessed identity path components change. Preserve relative/foreign roots, suffixes, configuration flags and all other fields; whole-checkpoint inverse proof retains original bytes

typed_allowlist.owner: Checkpoint state.last_trace and structured trace_path leaves
typed_allowlist.validation: First validate original canonical envelope/state and checksum. Original trace path must be an independently retained trace source allocation or observed run.finished path, with replay source allocation correspondence checked when supplied; no path is learned from the checkpoint itself
typed_allowlist.replacement: Only the witnessed root and preregistered Session/Run path components become canonical tokens. Unknown paths remain literal, and checksum substitution plus checkpoint-linkage-inverse retain full raw reconstruction

typed_allowlist.owner: Workspace line inside state.prompt.text's Runtime section only
typed_allowlist.validation: Original checkpoint bytes and SHA are valid; split only at the exact Runtime header and stop before the exact Project instructions header. Require the line's path to match an independently owned allocation-root boundary; identical prose elsewhere is excluded
typed_allowlist.replacement: Only the Runtime Workspace line's eligible path prefix/components change. Keep line endings, all other runtime values, project instructions and arbitrary matching user/model text literal; record exact containing-token replacement and whole-checkpoint inverse proof

typed_allowlist.owner: state.handoff.text beginning with the exact historical-conversation preamble
typed_allowlist.validation: Validate raw canonical envelope/state and SHA before parsing. Delegate only the typed transcript wrapper to the registered JSON normalizer, with all inner Run/path/result references independently witnessed; unbound scopes and invented trace envelopes are not identity evidence
typed_allowlist.replacement: Only recursively admitted typed transcript substitutions and necessary containing-string escaping change; preserve native omissions, ordinary prose, record order and plan/entry counts. Retain nested and whole-checkpoint inverse linkage

typed_allowlist.owner: Values, never keys, of checkpoint state.gc_state.paths
typed_allowlist.validation: Original checkpoint canonicality and state SHA must hold. Each eligible value is a typed path under an independently allocated capture root at a slash boundary; call IDs and GC bookkeeping are not identities or timing slots
typed_allowlist.replacement: Only owned path prefixes and already witnessed identity components change. Relative/foreign paths, map keys, dropped placeholders, GC ages/steps and ordering remain literal; retain leaf spans and whole-checkpoint inverse proof

typed_allowlist.owner: duration_ms on typed checkpoint history shell records only
typed_allowlist.validation: Validate raw checkpoint canonicality and checksum first; duration is an integer, not bool, nonnegative and no larger than the independently captured invocation elapsed bound in milliseconds
typed_allowlist.replacement: Only this duration becomes integer zero; command, stdout/stderr, signal, interruption, workspace and every other number remain governed by their own exact slots. Original duration and substituted token are retained for whole-checkpoint inverse replay

typed_allowlist.owner: Typed history ToolOutcome.workspace, shell.workspace and gc_state.inherited outcome workspace leaves
typed_allowlist.validation: First validate raw checkpoint canonical envelope/state and SHA. The workspace value must lie under an independently owned capture allocation root at a slash boundary; ordinary text/data is not searched for path-like strings
typed_allowlist.replacement: Replace only the owned workspace root/known identity components. Preserve outcome data, effects, command text, return status and foreign/relative paths; retain exact token and whole-checkpoint inverse linkage

typed_allowlist.owner: Version-2 checkpoint envelope.sha256 after admitted typed state substitutions
typed_allowlist.validation: Original raw-state SHA must match the original envelope before any substitution, except the exact A37.corrupt-checksum/C19.corrupt-checksum fixture whose sole declared delta is a literal leading zero. Original envelope/state canonical order, lexemes and bytes are checked without repairing them
typed_allowlist.replacement: SHA-256 of the actual substituted canonical state span; preserve the corrupt fixture's exact leading-zero delta. Never zero or mask a checksum, drop a field, or sort/reformat raw input. Record raw/substituted digest linkage and whole-checkpoint inverse proof

typed_allowlist.owner: Complete owned version-2 checkpoint artifact after its individually registered token/base64 substitutions
typed_allowlist.validation: Validate original canonical envelope/state and raw SHA, or check the exact named corruption delta without treating the corrupt state as valid. Build inverse spans using accumulated byte shifts and require applying them to normalized bytes to reconstruct every original artifact byte exactly
typed_allowlist.replacement: No additional mask: this row links the full original and normalized artifact, raw/substituted state digests, checksum-valid flag, exact corruption delta and inverse_verified result. Raw replay must reproduce all inner and enclosing rows before comparison

typed_allowlist.owner: Semantic correspondence certificate for complete retained agent/root trace sources and captured HTTP request ordering in agent-enabled cases only
typed_allowlist.validation: Actor slots derive recursively from accepted parent spawn-call chains. Preserve per-actor trace sequence and link each captured generative request exactly to retained api.attempt.started body bytes; logical slots are actor slot, witnessed RUN_n, positive Step and attempt. Source list is unique and HTTP source order is a complete permutation; raw replay reconstructs the same certificate
typed_allowlist.replacement: Only cross-agent asynchronous source/capture interleaving is projected into the certified causal order. No event/body/output/effect is dropped or merged; per-source event order, multiplicity and literal normalized bytes remain exact. Committed certificates retain logical slots/counts, not raw paths or identities

binding: The suite digest locks this policy, observer sources, inventory, normalized locks and samples together. This allowlist documents the exact executable predicates; it is not permission to add wider substitutions.

ledger_contract.rows: sorted multiset of artifact, typed path, substitution kind and multiplicity
ledger_contract.timing_sites: include eligible top-level trace timing slots even when already zero
ledger_contract.certificates: typed ownership and witness metadata; never raw values or raw digests
ledger_contract.closed_endpoint: legacy trace and independent invocation certificates share one site kind
ledger_contract.validation: complete raw replay must reproduce every original ledger row before locking
